en: When Technology Truly "Disappears": Reflections on Reading Weiser's The Computer for the 21st Century
zh: 当技术真正“消失”：阅读维瑟《21世纪的计算机》的心得与反思

excerpts.zh: 一件发热马甲，也能成为理解隐形计算的入口。
excerpts.en: A heated vest can be an entry point for understanding invisible computing.

excerpts.zh: 技术融入生活，不一定要以一台显眼的设备出现。
excerpts.en: Technology can fit into life without appearing as a conspicuous device.

excerpts.zh: 熟悉的文字会直接呈现意义，陌生语言却需要额外解码。
excerpts.en: Familiar writing conveys meaning directly; an unfamiliar language needs extra decoding.

excerpts.zh: 在德国看路牌的经历，让我想到技术的认知门槛。
excerpts.en: Reading street signs in Germany made me think about technology’s cognitive barriers.

excerpts.zh: 普适计算的愿景，是让技术在环境中提供帮助，而不是持续占据注意力。
excerpts.en: Ubiquitous computing imagines technology helping from the environment rather than constantly demanding attention.

excerpts.zh: 联网设备需要人反复配置时，计算还没有真正退到背景。
excerpts.en: When networked devices need repeated configuration, computing has not faded into the background.

excerpts.zh: 理解新概念时，熟悉的产品类比也可能误导我们。
excerpts.en: Familiar product analogies can mislead us when learning a new concept.

excerpts.zh: 把 Tabs 当作 AirTags，会忽略它作为交互媒介的设想。
excerpts.en: Equating Tabs with AirTags misses their envisioned role as interaction media.

excerpts.zh: 共享文件和共享一个协作空间，并不完全相同。
excerpts.en: Sharing a file and sharing a collaborative space are not quite the same.

excerpts.zh: 联网不自动等于环境中的设备能够动态协作。
excerpts.en: Being connected does not automatically mean devices can cooperate dynamically in an environment.

excerpts.zh: 当 AI 替人操作，依赖人浏览的商业模式也会受到影响。
excerpts.en: When AI acts for people, business models that depend on human browsing are affected.

excerpts.zh: 技术退到背景之后，人的选择权更需要被看见。
excerpts.en: When technology fades into the background, human choice needs to remain visible.
